name: Added to Cart Popup for WooCommerce – RedFox Added to Cart Popup
author: RedFox WP

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store into a conversion powerhouse! RedFox Added to Cart Popup is the ultimate solution for creating engaging, high-converting shopping experiences that keep customers engaged and drive more sales.

⚡ Why Choose RedFox Added to Cart Popup?

Every second counts in ecommerce. When customers add items to their cart, that’s your golden moment to capture their attention, build confidence, and guide them toward checkout. Our plugin turns that crucial moment into a powerful conversion opportunity with beautiful, customizable popups that delight customers and boost your bottom line.

🎯 Perfect For:
– Ecommerce Store Owners who want to increase conversion rates
– Marketing Teams looking to reduce cart abandonment
– UX Designers who prioritize customer experience
– Developers who need a flexible, modern solution

🌟 Powerful Features That Drive Results:

💡 Smart Display Options
– Just Added Product Mode – Showcase the specific item added
– Full Cart View Mode – Display complete cart contents to encourage larger orders
– Intelligent Auto-Hide – Automatically dismiss after customizable delays (1-30 seconds)
– Responsive Max Width – Perfect sizing for any device (300-800px)

🎨 Advanced Customization
– Visual Border Radius Controls – Professional corner styling with live preview
– Custom CSS Editor – Full syntax highlighting and autocompletion for developers

⚡ Performance & User Experience
– Lightning Fast – Optimized code with minimal impact on page speed
– Mobile-First Design – Perfect experience on all devices and screen sizes
– RTL Language Support – Works perfectly with right-to-left languages

💼 Business Benefits:

🎯 Increase Conversion Rates – Turn more visitors into customers with compelling popups
🛒 Reduce Cart Abandonment – Keep customers engaged at the crucial moment
💰 Boost Average Order Value – Show full cart contents to encourage larger purchases
📱 Improve Mobile Experience – Perfect popup experience across all devices
⚡ Maintain Site Speed – Lightweight code that doesn’t impact performance

🔧 Easy Setup & Management:

✅ One-Click Installation – Get up and running in under 5 minutes
✅ Intuitive Admin Panel – Modern interface that’s easy to navigate
✅ No Coding Required – Perfect for non-technical store owners

🌍 Works With Everything:

✅ All WooCommerce themes and plugins
✅ Popular page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.)
✅ Caching plugins (WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, etc.)
✅ Multilingual sites (WPML, Polylang compatible)
✅ WooCommerce 10.0+ and WordPress 6.8+

sections.installation:
🚀 Get Started in 3 Easy Steps:

Step 1: Install
– Go to your WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
– Search for “RedFox Added to Cart Popup”
– Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
sections.faq:
Will this work with my existing WooCommerce theme?

Absolutely! Our plugin is built to work seamlessly with ANY properly coded WooCommerce theme. We use smart positioning that ensures the popup displays perfectly over any design without conflicts.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Perfect mobile experience guaranteed! The popup is fully responsive and optimized specifically for mobile devices, tablets, and desktop screens. Your customers will love it on any device.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all! We’ve obsessed over performance. The plugin is built with modern, lightweight code that has minimal impact on your site speed.

Does it work with AJAX add to cart?

Yes! The plugin works flawlessly with both standard and AJAX add to cart functionality, including quick add to cart buttons and single product pages.

Is it compatible with caching plugins?

100% compatible! Works perfectly with all popular caching solutions including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, and more.
